title: APT-29 C2 Beaconing to Known Infrastructure
logsource:
  category: firewall
  product: fortinet
detection:
  c2_ip:
    dstip: '198.51.100.77'
  protocol:
    dstport: 443
    protocol: tcp
  condition: c2_ip and protocol
level: critical
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa21-131a
falsepositives:

author: SOC Team

rule Suspicious_Scheduled_Task_APT29 {
    meta:
        description = "Detects scheduled tasks used by APT-29 for persistence"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1053.005"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $task_cmd1 = "schtasks" wide nocase
        $task_cmd2 = "/create" wide nocase
        $task_cmd3 = "/sc ONLOGON" wide nocase
        $task_cmd4 = "powershell" wide nocase
    condition:
        all of ($task_cmd*)
}
